name: documay
description: Documay – scan a QR, send a file. Ephemeral, no-login file transfer.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n server,client -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w client"
